title: Run
description: One executor dispatch (one brief invocation against an executor). Records the dispatch parameters and trace pointers; does NOT duplicate trace contents (which live in the adapter-managed trace directory).

executor.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/executor-enum.yaml. Keep in sync.

dispatch_route.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/dispatch-routes.yaml. Keep in sync.

model.description: PM-facing alias OR wire model id. Aliases resolved via share/model-aliases.tsv.

brief_file.description: Absolute path to the brief markdown file (typically /tmp/brief-<slug>-XXXXXX.md).

state.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/run-states.yaml. Keep in sync.

operation_id.description: Shared key linking this Run row to its paired Event row for the same transition.

trace_path.description: Absolute path to the executor trace file. Run row does NOT include trace contents.
